verdict.rationale: Pipedrive has a dedicated first-party MCP server feature page. It says users can find deals, update records, get insights, move opportunities and automate workflows from their AI assistant, and a probe confirms the official MCP server is documented at that URL. The evidence is only marketing-level, though. Missing for 10: setup/connection documentation (auth method, endpoint, supported clients), a list of exposed tools, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Find deals, update records, get insights, move opportunities through your pipeline and automate workflows, all from your AI assistant.
